pylons_vi: 5 tháp hình vòm nhọn (chữ A cong), chân kim cương, cao ≈110 m
pylons_en: 5 pointed-arch (curved A) pylons with diamond feet, ≈110 m

pylon_custom.description: Pointed arch above the deck: two slightly curved legs straddle the 33 m deck and meet in a sharp apex, with no cross-beam above the deck. Below the deck the legs converge again into a single pier (diamond overall). Stays fan from the upper third of each leg to the deck edges. Pylons are lit at night in changing colours.

model3d.colour: grey concrete; colour-changing night lighting on the pylons
model3d.notes: Diamond foot seen in the 4am Commons view (legs converge below deck into one pier). Image 'Cau Nhat Tan, Ha Noi, VN 02' shows only the roadway; suggest replacing it.

review: Legs started at deck level (no diamond foot); one gallery image shows no bridge
